summary: Firm's written AML policy and procedures (v3.2, January 2024).

overlayBoxes.details: The firm's AML policy §2.3.2 permits utility bills dated within the last 6 months for address verification. CLC AML Guidance specifies utility bills must be less than 3 months old. The firm's written policy sets a lower standard than the regulatory guidance — any address verification relying on a utility bill between 3 and 6 months old would be non-compliant with CLC guidance even if compliant with the firm's own policy.
overlayBoxes.title: Firm Policy Allows Older Address Evidence Than CLC Guidance Permits
